name: MedXpert 医疗器械检测对接工具
description: Medical device testing coordination. Read-only tool for querying accredited testing labs, test method standards (IEC/ISO/GB), sample requirements and testing timelines across NMPA/FDA/MDR.
author: MedXpert (org)
